borough: London Borough of Barking and Dagenham
decision_conditions: <div><span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">The proposed development, by reason of its bulk, mass, scale, siting and design of the proposed two-storey side extension would present an undesirable addition to the dwelling, which would close off the openness of the corner plot, unbalance the symmetry and uniformity of the terrace row, thus impacting the character and appearance of the area, notably given the location of the application site within the Becontree Estate. Officers also consider the proposed front extension, including a front porch, to be overly prominent and dominate the front of the modest sized dwelling, particularly as it is in combination with the proposed two-storey side extension.</span>&nbsp;As such, the proposed development is contrary to:<br></div><div><br></div><div><p style="background-color: rgb(229, 229, 229);"><span pt="" sans",="" sans-serif;"="" style="font-size: 10.5pt;">- National Planning Policy Framework</span>&nbsp;(NPPF) (MHCLG, December 2024)<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="background-color: rgb(229, 229, 229);"><span pt="" sans",="" sans-serif;"="" style="font-size: 10.5pt; line-height: 14.98px;">- Polies D1, D4, D5, D6 and HC1 of the London Plan (March 2021)</span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="background-color: rgb(229, 229, 229);"></p><p style="background-color: rgb(229, 229, 229);"><span style="font-weight: 700;">-&nbsp;</span><span pt="" sans",="" sans-serif;"="" style="font-size: 10.5pt;">Policies SP2, SPP6 DMD1, DMD4 and DMD5 of&nbsp;</span>the London Borough of Barking and Dagenham’s Local Plan (September 2024)</p><p style="background-color: rgb(229, 229, 229);">- The Residential Extensions and Alterations Supplementary Planning Document (February 2012)</p></div>
description: Construction of a single storey side and front extension including a front porch, a first floor side extension, and a single storey rear extension
